intent: A plague bog at night: drowned grey-olive reed fields over brown-black mud, rotten orchards and stained stone, gibbets and poisoned wells on the road, a great ring of leaning headstones at the plague pit breathing sickly yellow-green light, and a drowned chapel lit on the skyline.
requests: A pit or hollow sculpt kind (or a terrain sink) so the plague pit can be an actual sunken hollow rather than a ring of stones on flat ground.
A gallows/gibbet sculpt kind that can hang a cage or body from its arm; the lamppost kind's arm and chain had to stand in for one.
A chapel or steeple sculpt/building kind for a drowned chapel silhouette; the plain tower kind had to stand in for one.
